query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date in <window>) WHERE h IN ('021a32ee5621d4e94df1d9bef6baa284a7cc75ba51bb5fb804c6c471', '0ccb659135a7098d40b5eaf97680c4d672ace8b13b750e95362f59ff', '26642ebb66bc7475a48d7e6939861b9f8a61af39f8a807bd9b38e03b', '5d8efd9c3cdb083697b682ab06f4f2659e8f1716329e77b27f22e044', '61161584261621d4dd4307d238fe23043ce8180780e5718048a692a8', '78bf460e558b50ffb1a56c5f0a523111831bc5a5d166b23771035b9c', '8952dc463eb173e8f71c78229fe071c3eca694968c71f61ee3491ebd', '8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61', '8ec464861107b2839a970a9bd790ce708e9e72fb97b07551a7bfc947', 'b3b8c8a67790404c647ed2dbdb9e40c62e3fcff37054c34713adf9d2', 'b7bf238c97a8f1b292b4e86416ae8496ecc2aac9b67c47360a0ef05e', 'c7c55ab902dc34968966d06e3ea1e2322178c83fe3218c05ddd17a75', 'd45f74956ff0d9a37d59f4f3bfad99d2797d8ccf77bcdc7c984da7f4', 'f780e15a96aa9ddeedd419404a9bb14c09a4c8deac716edeba87fe54') UNION ALL SELECT min(d) AS date, t AS tx_hash FROM (SELECT t, h, asset, min(d) AS d, sum(q) AS n FROM (SELECT tx_hash AS t, date AS d, coalesce(owner_stake_credential, owner_payment_credential, owner_addr) AS h, asset_unit AS asset, quantity AS q FROM address_utxo WHERE date in <window> AND policy_id IN ('8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61') UNION ALL SELECT i.spent_tx_hash AS t, i.date AS d, coalesce(a.owner_stake_credential, a.owner_payment_credential, a.owner_addr) AS h, a.asset_unit AS asset, -a.quantity AS q FROM tx_input i JOIN address_utxo a ON a.tx_hash = i.tx_hash AND a.output_index = i.output_index WHERE i.date in <window> AND a.policy_id IN ('8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61')) GROUP BY t, h, asset) WHERE n <> 0 GROUP BY t) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
